name: Accessibility pass
description: A practical a11y baseline: global styles contrast review, image alt-text coverage, heading structure spot-check on key pages, and safe fixes.

steps.title: Global styles
steps.detail: Call wp_get_global_styles and report text/background color pairs; compute contrast ratios and list the failing ones (fix via wp_update_global_styles only with owner confirmation).

steps.title: Alt-text coverage
steps.detail: Call wp_list_media (per_page=100) and list attachments with empty alt text; fix metadata with wp_update_media for the agreed ids.

steps.title: Key pages structure
steps.detail: Call wp_list_posts (post_type=page, status=publish) and wp_get_post for Home/About/Contact: report heading hierarchy breaks (multiple H1, skipped levels) with concrete suggested fixes.

steps.title: Apply heading fixes
steps.detail: For agreed pages, call wp_update_post to correct heading levels in the content; one page per call, verify after each.

steps.title: Report
steps.detail: Deliver: contrast findings, alt-text coverage percentage before/after, heading fixes applied, and the remaining manual items (theme-level, forms).

guardrails: Never rewrite page copy for a11y: structure and metadata only.
Color fixes go through global styles, never inline styles per block.
